caption: The drawing depicts a single clear glass goblet or dessert dish with a wide, shallow bowl and a short, round stem connecting to a broad, circular base. The glass bowl features an etched or engraved decorative band around its upper section, consisting of stylized leaves, grapes, and vines. The entire glass object is shaded with light grey and white highlights to suggest transparency and reflection. The drawing is placed centrally on a plain beige background. Near the bottom left, there is a simple horizontal scale with small vertical ticks. At the bottom right, the artist's name "John Dana" and the date "April 21, 1936" are handwritten in pencil.
title: Compote
